title: Kitab al-Asl
author: al-shaybani
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shaybani's great record of the doctrine of Abu Hanifa and Abu Yusuf, set out as questions and answers. It is the first and largest of the six books later called the zahir al-riwaya, the texts on which the authoritative Hanafi position rests. The OpenITI file used here holds sixteen of its books, from prayer to sales; the rest of the work is not in this transcription.
historicalContext: Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Shaybani studied with Abu Hanifa and then with Malik in Medina before serving as a judge under Harun al-Rashid. His books fixed the early Kufan school in writing, and al-Sarakhsi's al-Mabsut, already on this shelf, is in effect a commentary on the tradition they began.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
